title: Settings
subtitle: View and manage the settings of the Authway system.

tenant.title: Current tenant
tenant.help: The tenant you are working in.

tenantSettings.title: Tenant settings
tenantSettings.help: Rules that apply to the users of this tenant.

session.title: Administrator session
session.help: When you sign in with a console account, its memberships decide which tenants you can manage. The shared administrator password manages every tenant.
session.scopeOperatorSupport: All tenants (operator — inside a tenant through support access)

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.api: Authway API — manages tenants, clients and users
addresses.issuerHelp: The address applications put in their OIDC configuration

server.title: Server
server.notAnsweringHelp: The API’s /health could not be read
server.versionHelp: The API image that is running
server.databaseHelp: The last migration this version has

capabilities.title: What this deployment offers
capabilities.description: What the API answered at GET /api/v1/capabilities.
capabilities.mfaHelp: Users turn it on in the account screen

help.title: Need help?
help.body: Authway is a three-tier authentication platform built on Ory Hydra. For details, see <docs>the official documentation</docs>.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.help: Turning a tenant off stops every sign-in to it. Deleting cannot be undone.
danger.turnOffHelp: No client of this tenant can sign anyone in or get tokens, and the tokens it holds end. The default tenant cannot be turned off.
danger.turnOnHelp: Each client works as its own setting says again. Sessions that ended while it was off do not come back.
danger.deleteHelp: A tenant that still has users, clients or service credentials cannot be deleted — delete those first. The default tenant cannot be deleted.

deleteModal.title: Delete tenant
deleteModal.body: This deletes the tenant <name>{{name}}</name>. Only an empty tenant is deleted:
deleteModal.rule1: It is refused while users, clients or service credentials remain
deleteModal.rule2: The account screen client Authway created goes with it
deleteModal.rule3: Its terms documents and settings are no longer used
deleteModal.confirm: To confirm, type the tenant slug <slug>{{slug}}</slug>:

toast.deleteFailed: The tenant could not be deleted

deleteRefusals.tenant_has_users: The tenant still has users, so it cannot be deleted. Delete the users first.
deleteRefusals.tenant_has_clients: The tenant still has clients, so it cannot be deleted. Delete the clients first.
deleteRefusals.tenant_has_service_clients: The tenant still has service credentials, so it cannot be deleted. Revoke them first.
deleteRefusals.default_tenant_protected: The default tenant cannot be deleted.

form.name: Name
form.nameShort: The name needs at least two characters
form.inviteOnly: Invitation only — a first sign-in needs an invitation
form.open: Open — anyone gets an account by signing in for the first time
form.passwordMinHelp: Every tenant has a floor of 8 characters. It can only be raised.
form.passwordMinInvalid: A number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave empty ({{min}})
form.sessionHelp: How long a user’s sign-in session lasts. At most 43200 minutes (30 days).
form.sessionInvalid: 0 to {{max}} minutes (30 days), or leave empty (default)
form.auditHelp: Audit entries older than this are deleted daily. At least 30 days.
form.domainsHelp: When named, accounts are created only for addresses in these domains (invitations and first sign-ins). Empty: no limit. Existing accounts are unchanged.
form.saveFailed: Tenant settings could not be saved
